issues.detail: The Greek 'archiereos' is in the genitive case, modifying 'Skeua' (Sê-va). The Vietnamese translation 'một thầy tế lễ cả người Giu-đa' implies that Sê-va was 'the high priest of all Judah' or a similar collective title, whereas the Greek simply identifies him as 'the high priest of Judah'.
